snippet.title: Chick'n Slide - Pull Adorable Chicks onto Slides - Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
An incremental arcade experience where you pull adorable chicks onto giant slides, collect resources, unlock powerful talents, and upgrade your magnet to create ever-growing, chaotic runs.

play the demo https://store.steampowered.com/app/4567670/Chickn_Slide/
